snippet.title: Little Ghosties: Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
This is my latest game, Little Ghosties.

Little Ghosties is a cozy idle desktop companion game where little ghosts live in a terrarium on your desktop. Hatch and raise ghosts, pet and care for them, collect rare ghost types, hoover up slime, and unlock new items.

Little Ghosties is fully resizable, so it can live anywhere on your screen while you work, study, or play.

The Demo is available to play on Steam here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4584260/Little_Ghosties_Demo/

Wishlist Little Ghosties on Steam to support development

Music by Studio Chimp: https://www.studiochimp.com/

Discord: https://discord.com/invite/N7gRbtZuRk

Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/cw/AcrylicPixelGames
